summary: A 1935 L-4 cab on a north spur of Rivers Peak in the Lolo National Forest, which the page says was destroyed in 1955.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a north spur

events.note: Page dates an L-4 cab on the north spur to 1935.
Page says destroyed in 1955; no cause given.

evidence.supports: Lolo National Forest; 13 miles southeast of Lookout Pass
Lolo National Forest named as the unit
Page title calls the structure a fire lookout cabin
1935 L-4 cab on north spur; destroyed 1955
evidence.quote: 1935: L-4 cab on north spur. Destroyed 1955.

notes_for_editor: Two short sources only: the firelookout.com page and the FFLA Montana list, which agree on name, county, coordinates and gone status. Two searches found no other page on this lookout. A Mineral Peak lookout in Missoula County is a different site and was not used. Kind is open: the record says ground, the list says Ground, but the page says L-4 cab, and an L-4 cab may have stood on a tower; the sources do not settle it. Elevation 5,305 ft is about 1,617 m, which could fill elevation_m once an editor agrees. No corrections proposed.
